headline: TOR @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 3.95 at BOS 4.57, with a projected total of 8.51. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: TOR moved -0.17 runs while BOS moved +0.50, changing the projected margin by -0.67 runs. The projected total climbed +0.39, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Sonny Gray has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nathan Lukes, Ceddanne Rafaela, Willson Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
